what: Morningstar rates and analyses investments. It publishes fund research and star ratings, sells data and indexes to the industry, owns credit rating agency DBRS Morningstar, and runs the PitchBook private markets database.
customers: Financial advisers, asset managers, institutional investors and private equity professionals.
money: private company and venture capital data
DBRS Morningstar ratings, indexes and retirement services
moat: Fund ratings the industry treats as a standard, and in PitchBook a private markets dataset that no competitor has matched.
risks: 20 times earnings and only three analysts cover the stock
The Morningstar family controls the company, which limits outside influence
PitchBook's growth has slowed as venture capital activity fell
opportunities: A 15.3% net margin and $493M of free cash flow on $2.6B of revenue
Revenue grew from $1.7B to $2.4B in four years, most of it recurring subscriptions
Private markets keep growing as a share of investing, and PitchBook is the reference dataset for them
watch: PitchBook revenue growth and overall organic revenue growth.
